blockers: Do not launch inference until the DS5 manifest and evaluation-unit digests are sealed.
The portable raw-track family needs a DS5-local prepared cache; prior-dataset cache states are forbidden.
The current point/surface runners contain DS3/DS4 membership constants and need a narrow DS5 membership binding before execution.
The current cell-batched CLIs are DS4-bound and do not expose arbitrary single, all-group8, or rate-full units; a tested binding adapter is required.
Geometry methods are conditional on capture-time geometry bindings; absent bindings must yield explicit not_applicable rows, not dropped scans.
